description: jobs/storage.json: where the job queue keeps its state on the broker.

stream.description: The work-queue stream every job is published into.

subjectRoot.description: The root of the subjects the stream captures: a job is published on `<subjectRoot>.<jobType>`.

consumer.description: The durable consumer that delivers each job to the dispatcher holding its lease.

bucket.description: The KV bucket that keeps one record per job, keyed by the job's id.

record.description: The component schema each of the bucket's values is.
